universities.name: Madras School of Economics

logo.rights: Official Madras School of Economics identity asset supplied on its own public website, used intact for factual institutional identification. No open licence, ownership transfer or endorsement is claimed.

cover.rights: Official Madras School of Economics campus photograph supplied on its public website, used intact for factual campus identification and context. No open licence, ownership transfer or endorsement is claimed.
cover.altText: Madras School of Economics campus building and gardens, Chennai

universities.summary: Madras School of Economics is a specialist institution founded in Chennai in 1993. Its current taught portfolio includes integrated economics, five MA specialisations, data science and two MBAs. The economics and data-science routes combine quantitative study with applied work, while entry requirements differ by programme and applicant category.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Kotturpuram campus has air-conditioned classrooms, a library with computer and reading facilities, hostels, a mess and a cafeteria. Outdoor and indoor sports include football, cricket, basketball, volleyball, table tennis, chess and carrom.
universities.cityProfile: MSE is on Gandhi Mandapam Road in Kotturpuram, Chennai, behind the Government Data Centre and Anna Centenary Library. It is a single specialist campus for this profile, not the Central University of Tamil Nadu. Historical university partnerships should not be confused with the location or awarding arrangements for new MSE cohorts.
universities.practicalExposure: The economics portfolio includes quantitative methods, econometrics and specialised applications. The MA programmes include a summer internship after the second semester, while the Data Science programme requires a summer internship and a second-year dissertation. The integrated route adds programming and analytical study. A BA exit within the integrated programme is not an additional admissions route, and applied work does not guarantee employment.
universities.hostelOverview: MSE has separate accommodation for men and women; its integrated-programme brochure describes three girls’ hostels and one boys’ hostel. Hostel rooms remain subject to availability. The hostel page describes dining, common reading facilities, television and internet access.
universities.dietarySupport: The campus mess serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, and the cafeteria provides snacks, tea and coffee. Applicants with allergies or other dietary needs should confirm the arrangements directly rather than assume a dedicated service.
universities.safetyOverview: MSE identifies grievance and sexual-harassment prevention, anti-ragging and SC/ST committees. These provide institutional reporting channels; the presence of a committee is not a guarantee against incidents.
universities.studentSupport: The programme brochures identify separate student offices for admissions, including a direct route for foreign self-financing applicants. The campus library and reading rooms support academic work, and the grievance committees provide additional points of contact. Students Traffic can help organise a programme-specific application and full-cost plan.
whyChoose: Study economics through five distinct postgraduate specialisations rather than a single undifferentiated MA.
The integrated route provides staged exit awards within a continuous five-year economics curriculum.
Data Science includes both a summer internship and dissertation alongside quantitative and computing study.
thingsToConsider: The 2026 brochures impose programme-specific age, mathematics and academic-score conditions.
Published semester charges include category-specific components; they are not isolated annual tuition totals.
The two MBA sources disagree on important eligibility conditions, which require clarification before applying.
bestFitFor: Applicants comfortable with mathematics and quantitative approaches to economics.
Graduates comparing a specialised MA with an applied data-science master’s degree.
Applicants able to meet the exact academic and age rules of the selected Indian or foreign self-financing route.
recognitionBadges: UGC — institution established under State Legislature Act

faq.question: Which taught programmes are currently advertised?
faq.answer: MSE advertises an integrated MA in Economics, five two-year MA specialisations, MSc Data Science and MBAs in Finance and Business Analytics. Doctoral routes are separate research degrees.

faq.question: Are BA exit awards separate new-entry degrees?
faq.answer: The current integrated economics route has a three-year BA Honours exit and a four-year BA Honours with Research exit. These exits should not be represented as independently advertised new-entry programmes.

faq.question: Can foreign students apply to the economics and data-science programmes?
faq.answer: The 2026 brochures provide a self-financing direct-application route for foreign nationals. The designated MSE office receives the application, bio-data and academic qualifications; programme academic conditions still apply.

faq.question: Is mathematics required?
faq.answer: The integrated route requires Standard, Applied or Business Mathematics at 10+2. The MA and MSc routes require mathematics at 10+2 or equivalent, or qualifying undergraduate mathematical-economics study.

faq.question: Do the fee figures represent annual tuition?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed MSE brochures principally quote semester charges, with separate infrastructure and one-time admission charges. Indian, NRI and foreign-national tariffs differ.

faq.question: Is accommodation available?
faq.answer: MSE has separate men’s and women’s hostels, but availability must be confirmed. Its mess serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, with a separate cafeteria for snacks and drinks.

faq.question: Are the cited dates upcoming admissions deadlines?
faq.answer: No. The MA, integrated MA and MSc brochures concern the 2026 cohort. Their closed dates do not establish a future application window.

faq.question: What independent recognition is documented?
faq.answer: The UGC Annual Report 2022–23 lists MSE among institutions established under a State Legislature Act, with recognition from 1 April 2021. This is statutory institutional recognition, not an accreditation of every programme or a new 2026 order.

faq.question: Is an English language test required for foreign admission?
faq.answer: The currently linked MA and MSc ordinances require foreign applicants to demonstrate English proficiency. When English was not their first language or prior secondary/tertiary medium, the stated IELTS or TOEFL thresholds apply to scores no more than two years old. That rule is not automatically transferred to the integrated MA.

faq.question: Are the age limits the same for every route?
faq.answer: The 2026 integrated-MA brochure requires applicants to be under 22 on 1 July 2026. The MA and MSc brochures use under 25 on that date. These cycle-specific limits are not a prediction of the next admissions policy.

faq.question: Are financial-assurance documents the same as tuition fees?
faq.answer: No. Foreign-route MA documents permit the stated government fee-payment undertaking or a USD 5,000 bank balance; the MSc ordinance uses USD 10,000. These are financial-assurance requirements, not tuition quotations.

faq.question: How do fees change within the integrated degree?
faq.answer: The 2026–27 integrated handbook labels its first three years as the BA fee stage and says MA fees apply in years four and five. Foreign and NRI semester tariffs differ. Do not multiply one stage’s semester quote into a fixed five-year tuition total.

Madras School of Economics is a specialist institution founded in Chennai in 1993. Its current taught portfolio includes integrated economics, five MA specialisations, data science and two MBAs. The economics and data-science routes combine quantitative study with applied work, while entry requirements differ by programme and applicant category.

The Kotturpuram campus has air-conditioned classrooms, a library with computer and reading facilities, hostels, a mess and a cafeteria. Outdoor and indoor sports include football, cricket, basketball, volleyball, table tennis, chess and carrom.

MSE is on Gandhi Mandapam Road in Kotturpuram, Chennai, behind the Government Data Centre and Anna Centenary Library. It is a single specialist campus for this profile, not the Central University of Tamil Nadu. Historical university partnerships should not be confused with the location or awarding arrangements for new MSE cohorts.

The economics portfolio includes quantitative methods, econometrics and specialised applications. The MA programmes include a summer internship after the second semester, while the Data Science programme requires a summer internship and a second-year dissertation. The integrated route adds programming and analytical study. A BA exit within the integrated programme is not an additional admissions route, and applied work does not guarantee employment.

MSE has separate accommodation for men and women; its integrated-programme brochure describes three girls’ hostels and one boys’ hostel. Hostel rooms remain subject to availability. The hostel page describes dining, common reading facilities, television and internet access.

The campus mess serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, and the cafeteria provides snacks, tea and coffee. Applicants with allergies or other dietary needs should confirm the arrangements directly rather than assume a dedicated service.

MSE identifies grievance and sexual-harassment prevention, anti-ragging and SC/ST committees. These provide institutional reporting channels; the presence of a committee is not a guarantee against incidents.

The programme brochures identify separate student offices for admissions, including a direct route for foreign self-financing applicants. The campus library and reading rooms support academic work, and the grievance committees provide additional points of contact.
MSc Data Science requires a summer internship after the first year and a second-year dissertation.

UGC Annual Report 2022–23, printed p 142 table 2.2(i)(b)(v), names Madras School of Economics at its Chennai address under Institutions Established under State Legislature Act, with recognition date 1 April 2021. Printed p 95 describes this category among institutions empowered to award degrees under legislation.
